title: Project Support Administrator
description:
Project Support Administrator

Location: Stockport - SK4

Salary: Up to £30k (DOE) Annual Discretionary Bonus + Pension

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent. Office based

Based in Stockport, we are a specialist in the design and build of inspection and simulation machines. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project Support Administrator to join our team in a high impact, evolving role. This role will involve some project support, QC and warehouse administration and would very much suit someone with a can-do attitude who is prepared to make this role their own.

The role:
- Support the Operations team with all project administration tasks to ensure the requirements of our customers and company are met
- Managing project quality documentation, inspection records, material certification and final handover documentation in line with client and project requirements
- Work closely with other departments and suppliers to ensure documentation is accurate, controlled, traceable, and delivered within project timelines.
- Manage project quality documentation and submission schedules
- Manage document control, revisions, and client submissions
- Support audits, NCR closure, and compliance activities
- Assist with QC reporting and continuous improvement initiatives
- Warehouse Administration support including goods in and goods out (small warehouse function)
- Placing orders for supplies and monitoring delivery timescales to ensure goods arrive in a timely manner and don t delay assembly/shipping of goods
- Maintaining accurate records of deliveries.
- Compliant with regulations and quality standards.
- Dealing with Customer Care regarding priorities and answering queries
- Communicating and collaborating with other departments to optimize logistics processes.
- A willing attitude to assist in other areas of the business if required
- Must be eligible to work in the UK as visa sponsorship cannot be provided.

The Person:
- Minimum of 3 years relevant experience preparing quality/project documentation within an engineering or manufacturing environment
- Understanding of the warehouse function
- Good document control and organisational skills
- Good communication and stakeholder management skills
- ISO 9001 knowledge
- Internal and external audit experience
- IT Literate (Microsoft Office)
- A desire to learn and become a dependable and valued member of the team

The package
- Circa £30k salary dependant on experience
- Christmas closure normally 4 days.
- 20 days holiday.
- Remote working.
- Company Pension.
- Yearly salary review.
- Flexible start and finish time.

title: Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Scheduling Coordinator

Location: Altrincham
Salary: £30,000 £32,000
Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday (9am - 5:30pm)
Job Type: Permanent

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Scheduling Coordinator to join a busy and growing operations team based in Altrincham.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in scheduling, coordination, dispatch or logistics, ideally within a technical, engineering or field-service environment.

You will play a key role in coordinating a team of engineers, ensuring visits are scheduled efficiently, customers are kept informed and engineers have everything they need to complete their work successfully.

The role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is highly organised and enjoys problem-solving when priorities change throughout the day.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and coordinate engineer schedules for installations, service visits, repairs and urgent callouts.
- Manage daily, weekly and monthly schedules, balancing workloads and engineer availability.
- Monitor live schedules and respond quickly to cancellations, delays, changing customer requirements and urgent requests.
- Maintain accurate job and scheduling information within Salesforce and internal systems.
- Coordinate with engineers to ensure they have the correct job information, site instructions, documentation and customer requirements.
- Track engineer movements and job progress, proactively identifying and escalating potential delays.
- Liaise with internal teams including Projects, Operations, Service Desk, Account Management and Finance.
- Act as a key point of contact for customers regarding scheduled visits and provide updates where arrangements change.
- Prepare and manage permits and RAMS documentation, ensuring information is accurate and compliant.
- Arrange accommodation and travel requirements for engineers where necessary.
- Review monthly timesheet information and investigate any discrepancies.
- Process fixed penalty fees where required.
- Maintain scheduling records, databases and reports.
- Support the wider team with identifying opportunities to improve scheduling and field-service processes.

About You

We are looking for someone who has previous experience in a scheduling, coordination, dispatch or logistics role, ideally where you have been responsible for managing multiple engineers, technicians, contractors or field-based employees.

You will ideally have:
- Proven experience working within a scheduling or coordination environment.
- Hands-on experience using Salesforce
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm under pressure.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach.
- Experience working with scheduling, tracking or operational systems.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.

Desirable Experience

Experience within a technical, engineering, installation, field service or project environment would be advantageous. Knowledge of permits, RAMS, compliance documentation or engineer site requirements would also be beneficial, although full training can be provided to the right candidate.

What's On Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 £32,000
- Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
- Based in Altrincham
- Permanent position
- Opportunity to join a busy and established operations team
- Varied role with plenty of responsibility and opportunity to make an impact

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Recruitment Coordinator
Sale, Manchester
£28,638 - £29,497 per annum upon successful probation period
Permanent, Full Time (37.5 hours per week)

Please note, this role is office based only

Stockdales is a charity based in Sale, just south of Manchester City Centre, with a wealth of experience in making a difference to children, young people and adults with learning disabilities.

We are seeking a Recruitment Coordinator to play a key role in helping us attract, recruit and welcome the people who make a difference across our organisation. It's a varied role where no two days are the same, giving you the opportunity to build relationships, get involved in recruitment events and use your creativity to attract new talent.

So, if you have exceptional communication and organisational skills, experience working in a recruitment role and share our passion for recruiting the top talent, then we would love to hear from you!

About the role

You'll support the full recruitment and onboarding process, from completing pre-interview questionnaires and coordinating applications to assisting with, and where appropriate conducting, interviews across our care homes and services. You'll use our Applicant Tracking System (IRIS) every day to manage candidate applications, maintain accurate records and ensure information is kept up to date.

You'll also be out and about representing Stockdales at job fairs and recruitment events, helping to promote our vacancies and connect with potential candidates. Using Canva, you'll create engaging recruitment adverts for social media and help identify the most effective channels for reaching new applicants. You'll also support the development of relationships with recruitment agencies and explore new ways to build our candidate pool. From time to time, you may also help deliver presentations about Stockdales and the opportunities available to join our team.

Alongside your recruitment responsibilities, you'll provide a range of general administrative support to the team. This will include answering calls and responding to queries from professionals, colleagues and external contacts, preparing induction packs, maintaining departmental records and databases, organising meetings and appointments, and producing reports and documents using Microsoft Office.

It's a role that combines people, organisation, creativity and communication - perfect for someone who enjoys variety and wants to make a real contribution to building great teams.

About you

Our ideal candidate will be an experienced recruitment and onboarding professional who is confident conducting interviews and has experience using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS). With strong interpersonal and administrative skills, you will be highly organised, able to multitask and prioritise a demanding workload, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

You will be IT proficient, with experience using a range of computer software including Microsoft Office, databases, email, and internet-based programmes. Experience in public speaking or delivering presentations to groups is also desirable. You will be reliable, proactive, and motivated to improve processes, with the ability to provide practical solutions in a calm and methodical manner. A full driving licence and access to a vehicle is essential.

What you will receive whilst working for us:
- 28 days holiday per year pro rata inclusive of bank holidays
- Increased holiday entitlement with service
- Pension Scheme
- Medicash - includes access to 24hr GP, money off shopping and going out, wellbeing aids
- Life Insurance Scheme
- Excellent internal and external training
- Monthly staff prize draw
- Stream - Access to salary early
- Ongoing professional development, guidance, and support from experienced managers.
- Friendly, supportive environment.

Come and join our amazing team and help us achieve our mission - to help people live their lives to the full so they can experience the hope, joy and challenge that life brings.

Please refer to the job description upon submitting your application.

Stockdales is committed to being an equal opportunities employer, with a values-based recruitment process.

title: GP Receptionist
description: We are looking for a receptionist to join our team for 31 hours a week: The successful candidate will be required to be flexible with hours between 7am-8pm Monday to Friday to accommodate staff holidays etc. The shift pattern will be: The shift pattern will be fixed: Monday - 7am -2pm Tuesday- 12pm- 7pm Wednesday- 1pm- 8pm Thursday- 8am-1pm Friday- 2pm- 7pm The successful candidate will be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception and administrative duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, patient registration, booking appointments, processing of information (electronic and hard copy) and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. To support the practice clinical team by signposting patients to the appropriate healthcare professional or service, working as part of the practices multidisciplinary team. The receptonist will also be expected to undertake reception duties as part of the role, supporting the administrative team in delivering a polite and professional service to the entitled patient population. The following are the core responsibilities of the Receptionist.There may be, on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks; this will be dependent on factors such as workload and staffing levels: a. Process and effectively signpost patients to the appropriate healthcare professional depending on the presenting condition b. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers requests appropriately c. Process patient requests for appointments d. Process repeat prescription requests via prescription clerk e. Initiate contact with and respond to requests from patients, team members and external agencies f. Enter read/SNOMED CT code data on EMIS Web g. Photocopy documentation as required h. Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required i. Input data into the patients healthcare records as necessary j. Direct requests for information, e.g., SAR, insurance/solicitors letters and DVLA forms, to the administrative team k. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner l. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times m. Monitor and maintain the reception area and noticeboards n. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested o. Undertake all mandatory training and induction programmes

title: Medical Receptionist/ Care Navigator

A background of administration and/or customer service would also be considered. Accepting new registrations, completing relevant paperwork Accepting and booking travel immunisation APTS. Ensuring reception well stocked with sample pots/ forms/ registration packs. Answering telephone queries/appointments when necessary. (will only be necessary when only 3 or less members of staff on duty.
